integrity: Finite small-order cuts are exhaustively certified in exact arithmetic; the unrestricted results rely on analytic arguments; historical originality is qualified.
scientific_limitations: Exact operator norm beyond five dimensions is not proved. The theorem concerns finite real vectors, uniform mean centering, and unweighted complete-pair Gini variation. An unindexed equivalent result might exist.
title: The five-site Gini-contraction boundary for centered discrete primitives
